display_long_description:
Real Anatomy transforms the way you learn and explore the human body. Step inside an immersive 3D environment where every organ, muscle, and system comes to life in full detail. Designed for students, educators, and medical enthusiasts, this app makes complex anatomy simple, engaging, and interactive.

Explore the body layer by layer — from skeletal structure to organs, muscles, and the nervous system. Rotate, zoom, and interact with realistic models to gain a deeper understanding of how the human body works.

Key Features:
🌐 Full 3D models of major human body systems
🧠 Layer-by-layer exploration of bones, muscles, and organs
🎓 Designed for students, teachers, and medical training
🖐 Interactive tools for rotating, zooming, and highlighting parts
📚 A powerful aid for self-study, classrooms, or professional learning

Whether you’re preparing for exams, teaching in a classroom, or just curious about the wonders of the human body, Real Anatomy provides a hands-on, immersive experience that goes beyond textbooks. Enter the future of learning — in VR.
